title: Interactive Parking Rectangle Algorithm Visualization
description: Dive into the fascinating world of autonomous parking with this interactive visualization tool 🚗💻. Explore the core mechanics of the parking rectangle algorithm, which simulates precise vehicle positioning in urban environments. Key parameters include the street center point (v) for accurate alignment, orientation angle (θ) to handle varied road angles, and rectangle dimensions (K, H, W) defining the parking space boundaries 📐. Users can manipulate these variables in real-time to observe how adjustments impact parking success rates and collision avoidance. This hands-on demo highlights algorithmic efficiency in tight spaces, showcasing step-by-step rendering of the vehicle's path from approach to final slot occupancy 🎯. Ideal for students, developers, and robotics enthusiasts, it demystifies complex geometry calculations behind self-parking tech. Discover potential applications in smart cities, from optimizing EV charging spots to enhancing fleet management systems 🌆. With intuitive controls and dynamic graphics, gain insights into why orientation and dimensional accuracy are pivotal for seamless urban navigation 🚀. Whether troubleshooting code or visualizing AI-driven maneuvers, this resource bridges theory and practice in computational geometry.
